title: GOV-0121: delimit the doctrine's guarded sections with explicit sentinels instead of inferring them from heading depth
objective: Re-anchor the two admission-section slices in the activation tests onto explicit end sentinels, so that inserting a '## ' heading inside a guarded section can no longer truncate it, and so that a deleted sentinel raises rather than silently widening the slice.
business_value: 32 token assertions were scoped by heading depth in a file with 104 headings, and nothing told an editor which two were load-bearing. The failure surfaced as a missing citation, sending the editor to re-add prose already present -- so the cost was misdirected debugging, not a red test.
in_scope: docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md: one end sentinel per guarded admission section
tests/_doctrine.py: section()/end_marker() helper that raises on a missing, duplicated or misplaced sentinel
tests/test_badf_git_activation.py and tests/test_badf_build_activation.py: slices re-anchored, 32 assertions unchanged
tests/test_badf_doctrine_sections.py: the guard, incl. a positive control planting a heading inside each section
out_of_scope: Any change to the 32 token assertions themselves -- this is a re-anchoring, not a rewrite
The other 102 '## ' headings in the doctrine file
#313's unresolvable $ref work (held by SARCHI pending a file-list check)
#306's frozen-payload divergence and #304's enumeration vacuity -- queued, explicitly not folded in
acceptance_criteria: Both admission sections are delimited by explicit start/end markers; neither slice consults '\n## '
Inserting a '## ' heading inside a guarded section no longer truncates it -- proven by a positive control that asserts the OLD slice loses the token while the new slice keeps it
A missing, duplicated or misplaced sentinel RAISES DoctrineSectionError naming the marker, what is scoped by it, and the record (#279) -- never degrading to the rest of the file
All 32 existing token assertions continue to pass unchanged

test_obligations.claim: an inserted '## ' heading does not truncate a guarded section, and the old slice demonstrably did
a missing sentinel raises and names the coupling rather than widening the slice to the rest of the file

note: Lean ADVISORY. Ladder stop at 6 (minimum change to existing code) plus one small helper module, following the tests/_scratch.py precedent; a markdown-parser dependency was rejected at rung 4.
